discription: A mellow pad sound created by detuned saw waves, shaped with a resonant low-pass filter and a long ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.8, sustain=0.5, release=1.0, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq * [0.99, 1.01]) + Saw.ar(freq * [0.995, 1.005]); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
